title: Congrats on your new NFT!
summary: You just claimed an NFT with DropCain. Learn what's next!
author: Nathaniel Thoreson
body:
Congratulations!

You’ve just claimed your NFT using DropChain, the easiest way to grow and engage communities with NFTs.

DropChain is the simplest solution for small businesses, content creators, and community managers to leverage the power of NFTs. Our no-code NFT claim page makes it effortless for anyone to create and distribute NFTs, to grow your community and brand loyalty.

What's Next?

You will soon receive an email with more details about your NFT. This email will include all the relevant transaction data and additional information about your newly acquired digital asset.

The NFT can also now be found in your DropChain Wallet.
